Scope and player interaction

Keep saved identities stable across renamed assets, new content and software patches. Never interpret an unknown saved item/class/quest as permission to delete player progress.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase05committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

CheckingVersions → Compatible → MigrationRequired → MaintenanceRequired → UnknownDefinition → RejectedBuild

WBP_Loading observes results from URPGContentVersionGate. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_ContentVersion_Development. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
ProtocolVersion: network message schema compatibility
CatalogHash/DefinitionRevision: immutable released content identity
DatabaseSchemaVersion and MigrationId: ordered applied migration record
SaveRecordVersion: per serialized model shape
DefinitionRedirects: old ID -> new ID with reviewed migration reason
MinimumClientBuild: backend-enforced compatibility gate

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGContentVersionGateImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_LoadingLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
ValidateClientBuild(BuildId, ProtocolVersion, CatalogHash) -> Compatible|PatchRequired
ResolveDefinitionId(StoredId, RecordVersion) -> Definition|Redirect|Quarantined
ApplyMigration(MigrationId, ExpectedSchemaVersion) -> Applied|AlreadyApplied|PreconditionFailed; operator-only
ValidateCharacterSnapshot(Snapshot) -> Ready|QuarantinedRecord

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Assign stable semantic definition IDs independent of Content Browser file names and never recycle an old ID for a different item.
  2. Author a migration with preconditions, data transformation, uniqueness checks, estimated lock/downtime and forward-recovery plan. Test on a restored staging copy.
  3. Backend records each migration transaction/version and rejects incompatible servers until the catalog/schema set is supported.
  4. At login/transfer, validate protocol, content and record versions before possession. Resolve reviewed redirects; quarantine unknown/inconsistent records for repair instead of granting default replacements repeatedly.
  5. Deploy backward-compatible expand changes first, update services/servers/clients, migrate data, and contract old columns only after rollback window ends.
  6. Patch acceptance replays old quest/inventory/skill/fishing receipts and verifies no duplicate reward, changed GUID or lost currency.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create DA_ContentVersion_Development with ProtocolVersion=1 and an explicitly generated catalog manifest hash; do not use a hand-entered hash disconnected from cooked content.
  2. Add version checks to login, zone reservation, transfer redemption and persisted snapshot decode.
  3. Write numbered migration specifications under Backend/GameService/Migrations in the implementation repository; this manual provides contracts, not runnable backend code.
  4. Create fixture records with an old item ID, unknown recipe, obsolete skill node and already-completed quest reward.
  5. Run migration twice on disposable database copies; second application reports AlreadyApplied with unchanged counts.
  6. Reopen WBP_Loading to display PatchRequired or RecoveryRequired and avoid endless reconnect loops.

Reopen Phase05 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_NetworkLab / schema-v1 and schema-v2 disposable databases. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Unknown item ID -> quarantine/report while retaining owned record; no silent deletion or repeated compensation.
Migration interrupted before commit -> old schema/data remain or resumable explicit migration state; rerun does not double-transform.
Client catalog newer/older unsupported -> PatchRequired before live zone admission.
Redirect cycle -> content validation fails.
Restore backup from older schema -> apply tested forward migrations in isolation before live admissions.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Use one released catalog version per compatible deployment initially. Supporting multiple simultaneous catalogs is a later operational feature, not a default requirement.

Log schema/catalog/protocol versions with migration and repair IDs. Keep a human-readable release manifest and restore evidence; exclude personally identifying rows from public examples.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
